officialGoogleGuidanceChecked.note: Course list enhancement requires at least three courses and list/carousel markup. Brick 6 therefore does not claim Course-list eligibility for the two-level Public Speaking architecture.

redirectHardening.note: All four legacy Basic/Advanced course alias variants are direct 301 redirects, classified as redirects in the public route manifest, non-indexable in the SEO registry, excluded from sitemaps, and protected by smoke/infrastructure tests.

findingsFixed: Separated the ordered two-level Public Speaking schema from unordered Spoken English and Confidence specialist alternatives.
Changed shared course-detail copy from stage to level for Speaking while preserving Phonics stage wording and schema.
Made Speaking course sitemap lastmod depend on the files that actually render/configure those course pages and refreshed current sitemap dates.
Hardened bare and trailing-slash Basic/Advanced legacy course aliases across Firebase, SPA routing, route manifest, SEO registry, smoke and infrastructure tests.
Corrected a contradictory SEO smoke contract that simultaneously treated retired Public Speaking/Spoken-English aliases as required core sitemap URLs and legacy-absent URLs.
Added Public Speaking Excellence to required canonical core sitemap coverage.
